description: Header file defining the CordRepBtreeNavigator class for navigating CordRepBtree data structures, including methods for initialization, traversal, seeking, and reading data edges.

classes.name: absl::cord_internal::CordRepBtreeNavigator
classes.description: A bi-directional navigator for traversing CordRepBtree data structures, supporting initialization, movement, seeking, and reading operations.

methods.name: operator bool
methods.description: Checks if the navigator instance is not empty.

methods.name: btree
methods.description: Returns the current CordRepBtree being navigated.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current data edge in the navigation.

methods.name: InitFirst
methods.description: Initializes the navigator to the first data edge of the given tree.

methods.name: InitLast
methods.description: Initializes the navigator to the last data edge of the given tree.

methods.name: InitOffset
methods.description: Initializes the navigator to a specific offset within the tree, returning the position.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Moves to the next data edge.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves to the previous data edge.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific offset within the tree, returning the position.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the current position.

methods.name: Skip
methods.description: Skips a number of bytes forward from the current position.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the navigator to an empty state.
